newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Corp shares suspended for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: All Corp shares suspended for Thursday.

text.p: Trade in shares of Japanese non-bank All Corp were suspended for Thursday on the over-the-counter market, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said.
The JSDA added that the halt in trade stemmed from the need to clarify media reports saying the non-bank financial firm would apply for court protection for special liquidation by the end of March.

The financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Wednesday that All Corp would announce soon that it would apply for court protection by the end of March for special liquidation with debts of about 350 billion yen.
All Corp said that it would hold a news conference at 0130 GMT.
